source_notes: Springfield posts minutes in its document library (https://www.springfieldfl.net/document-library, category 'Minutes'). The springfieldfl.org domain does not resolve; the city site is springfieldfl.net. Every minutes file from July 2024 through Oct. 5, 2026 was downloaded; the PDFs are scans, so their text was produced by OCR (tesseract). Word files were read directly.

Springfield minutes record most votes as 'Roll Call: All ayes; motion carried (5-0)' and name each member in the roll call at the top. Members listed present are recorded as 'yes' on unanimous votes. Where the minutes record a 4-0 vote, the member listed as absent (or, on Sept. 3, 2024, not yet arrived) is marked absent.
The one split vote found was Ordinance 600 (Nov. 4, 2024): the roll call lists Mayor Hammond 'nay' but the minutes print the result as '(4-0)'; it is recorded here as 4-1.

FY2025 and FY2027 final budget hearings: the Sept. 16, 2024 'Special Called Commission Meeting/Workshop' minutes contain the FY2025 final hearing (Resolutions 24-22 and 24-23), and the Sept. 22, 2026 minutes contain the FY2027 final hearing (Resolutions 26-11 and 26-12). The FY2025 entry in votes.json (2024-09-16, Resolution 24-23, votes unknown) should be replaced by the entry here. Budget totals come from the adopted resolutions (media 10171 and 10891).

Entries already in votes.json (Sept. 3, 2024 tentative millage and budget; Sept. 2, 4 and 15, 2025; Dec. 1, 2025 bypass pump and SRF loan; Feb. 2, 2026 Nature Park) were not repeated, except that several items from those meetings that were missing are added.

Routine items (minutes, consent agendas, lot splits, variances, surplus property, holiday closings, proclamations) were skipped. Zoning and land-use ordinances are included only when the vote was split.
